meta.name: help
meta.description: Choose Phoenix review, plan, debug, or test command. Use when user asks which /phx: command or plugin skill handles a task; do not route only to a domain skill. NEVER for bare /help; NOT for ambiguous requests (use intent-detection) or a plugin tour.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速找到最合适的 Phoenix 命令或技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常在 Phoenix 开发中不确定该用哪个命令或插件
copy.tagline_en: Find the right Phoenix command or skill quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often hesitate over which Phoenix command or plugin to use during development

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析当前上下文（如 Git 状态、已有计划文件）或用户描述，然后从工具目录中推荐最合适的 /phx: 命令或插件技能，给出精确语法和后续步骤。只做一项推荐，最多问一个澄清问题。
howto.when: 当用户询问哪个 /phx: 命令或插件技能可以处理某个任务时触发。不应用于裸的 /help 或模糊请求，也不用于插件导览。

say.text: 如何使用插件调试这个问题？

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes context (Git status, plans) or user description, then recommends the best /phx: command or skill from the catalog, giving exact syntax and next steps. It makes one recommendation and asks at most one clarifying question.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks which /phx: command or plugin skill handles a task. Not for bare /help or ambiguous requests, nor for a plugin tour.

say_en.text: How do I debug this with the plugin?
How do I add a new feature?
